source: Player-supplied self-contained private worker Celesta check-in reference
greeting: Thank you for dropping by. I'll make sure to check you in!
alreadyDoneExample: You have already checked in today.
refusalExample: This feature is for registered users only.

playerRequirements.firstGoal: A fresh correlated server count of at least 30; no separate prize or legend read is required.
playerRequirements.repeatAfterGoal: Explicitly optional and default off; retain first completion evidence.
playerRequirements.registration: Registered for all 30 days; one code needs every day, a missed day may require a second code.
playerRequirements.level: No requirement reported; not independently established.
playerRequirements.markRollover: Player reports mark number may reset to 1 around mark 27; exact threshold unverified.

limits: No real NPC serial, pursuit or step is asserted by the synthetic packet examples.
The VPS map label does not replace existing route dimensions or collision evidence.
Yearless registration expiry does not establish a subscription end timestamp.
The private worker channel allowlist is not a DATester live capture.
No full automatic run or 30-day completion on this client is certified.
